dedupe_keys.name: vme a satellite imagery dataset and benchmark for detecting vehicles in the middle east and beyond

description: VME: A Satellite Imagery Dataset and Benchmark for Detecting Vehicles in the Middle East and Beyond is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Noora Al-Emadi et al. Detecting vehicles in satellite images can inform traffic management, urban planning, and disaster response. However, current models struggle with real-world diversity, particularly across different regions. This challenge is amplified by geographic bias in existing datasets, which often focus on specific areas and overlook regions like the Middle East. Coverage: global; published in 2025. Formats: JSON, TXT, Image. The data are held in Zenodo and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC BY-NC-ND 4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
